it.

1. **`Order`** ([models.py](file:///workspace/shopkit/orders/models.py#L20)) — added `gift_message: str = ""`.

2. **`Parcel` + `split_into_parcels`** ([fulfillment.py](file:///workspace/shopkit/orders/fulfillment.py#L13-L16)) — added `gift_message: str = ""` to `Parcel`; `split_into_parcels` copies `order.gift_message` onto the **first** parcel only (`gift_message=order.gift_message if n == 1 else ""`).

3. **`packing_slip`** ([fulfillment.py](file:///workspace/shopkit/orders/fulfillment.py#L38-L44)) — prints `Gift message: <msg>` (only when non-empty) after the weight line.

4. **API serializer** ([serializers.py](file:///workspace/shopkit/api/serializers.py#L24-L25)) — the `order()` representation now includes `"gift_message": o.gift_message`.

5. **Invoices** — `render_invoice_text` ([render.py](file:///workspace/shopkit/invoices/render.py)) was left untouched and never references the field, so customer invoices do not show the gift message.

Verified end-to-end: first parcel carries the message and prints it on the slip, later parcels don't; the API dict includes it; the invoice omits it; and orders without a gift message default to empty. Full suite: **105 passed**.
